body: :+1: thanks - overlooked that  your able to do that.
This is a problem when using with ng-forward as the @Component decorator defaults to restrict: 'E' and currently the is no way to override it.
You have to use the @Directive decorator if you want to use the component router with ng-forward
@petebacondarwin said he would fix the router soon to support components created with 1.5. See https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/6796
